title: inga vera subsp. spuria
intro: Inga vera subsp. spuria, commonly known as the wild guanabana or guanabana de monte, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used for centuries to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Inga vera subsp. spuria include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as fever, diarrhea, and respiratory infections. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties.
